title: theOS owns avenSANDBOX
note: theOS takes avenSANDBOX whole (D-33): its name, its image with every tool, its image workflow and its cloud setup. avenDB's release, peer image and deploy stay parked; the release is AIP-5.

questions.q: Move avenSANDBOX into theOS (theOS owns it and its release from then on), or copy it and leave avenDB's release where it is? And who releases the box afterwards?
options: Copy it into theOS; avenDB keeps releasing until theOS's copy passes its gates (recommended: no release path changes before Gate A)
Move it: theOS owns it and its release now

questions.q: Gate A for AIP-2, after its spec review: are its claims, assumptions, checkpoint plan, outcome and mockup what must be true?

who: Samuel Andert, who wants one authority for what ships.
avenMAIA, which lives in the box: the cloud environment avenSANDBOX warms every new session with the box's image.
problem.experience: avenSANDBOX gives every scenario the same clean box (a cloud session, a GitHub runner, a Mac with OrbStack): one image with every tool, built by its own workflow and tagged by its inputs. But its definition lives in avenDB, its workflow is parked, and its build reads avenDB's Cargo files, so theOS's checks have no box of their own.

items.text: avensandbox.yml released avenOS, avenSANDBOX and avenPEER from production, each under a dated version; the last release is #1750 (avenOS 26.10.31v6, avenPEER 26.10.31v5, avenSANDBOX 26.10.31v2).
avensandbox-image.yml and avenpeer-image.yml built their images from aven/DB2's Cargo workspace.
avendeploy.yml deployed the avenCEO Peer and avenOS at aven.maia.city, by hand.
aven/DB2/sandbox/box/Dockerfile compiles avenDB's third-party crates; cloud-setup.sh runs avenDB's bun run up, four avenDB peers, once before the snapshot.
This session: dockerd is not running; /var/log/dockerd.log last written 29 Oct; /var/lib/docker holds 24 GB; bun, node and Chromium (/opt/pw-browsers) come with the base image.
The environment's setup script looks only for aven/DB2/sandbox/box/cloud-setup.sh, and exits 0 when it is not there (aven/DB2/SANDBOX.md, "Samuel's part").

problem.baseline: Before the park: four workflows, all avenDB's. theOS has no box, no workflow and no release of its own.
whys: theOS's checks have no clean box of their own. Why? avenSANDBOX's image is defined, tagged and built from avenDB's files, and its workflow is parked with avenDB's.
Why? It was built for avenDB (29 to 31 Oct) before theOS became the standalone project (D-4).
Root cause: avenSANDBOX belongs to a legacy project.
truths: GitHub runs the workflow files of the branch an event happens on; a file moved out of .github/workflows/ on that branch never runs there.
A deployed server keeps serving what it was last given until something deploys again.
An image already published to a registry stays pullable when its workflow stops.
A workflow file must live in .github/workflows/; what it runs can live in theOS/.
assumptions: avenSANDBOX's tools stay as they are: Playwright with Chromium, Rust stable with wasm32 and wasm-bindgen, the nightly with cargo-fuzz, bun, elan with Lean, versitygw, clang and llvm (D-33).
Only avenDB's own parts stay behind: the step that compiles avenDB's crates, its compose file and its four peers. avenDB's `bun run up` stops working when the box moves; avenDB is parked.
The image keeps its name, ghcr.io/myavenceo/aven/sandbox; old tags stay in the registry.
Changing the environment's setup script is a setting only you can change; you paste it at Gate B.
problem.risk: Can be undone: the move by git mv back (tried in a scratch checkout); the environment's script by pasting the previous one, kept in theOS/sandbox/; the image's old tags stay pullable. The environment's script is shared by every session in it. production is frozen by its ruleset; it moves with the release (AIP-5).

reuse.use: Learned from: production takes changes from main only; one release per changed package, under the date (26.10.29, 26.10.29v2, ...); a push that changes nothing releases nothing.
Learned from: the image is tagged by the hash of the files its build reads, so every checkout runs exactly its own box; built per architecture, then joined.

reuse.what: aven/DB2/sandbox/box/cloud-setup.sh and the environment's setup script
reuse.use: Learned from: warm the box once, before the disk is snapshotted; never fail a session.
Learned from: run by hand in the environment production; health checks after the deploy; nothing secret printed, the repository is public.

claims.promise: Once the park is on main, avenDB's release, peer-image and deploy workflows do not run on main, and nothing live changes. Branches made before the park keep their copies until they merge main.
claims.fails: A parked workflow still runs on main, or the park takes something down.
claims.check: After the merge: main's Actions runs show none of the three; aven.maia.city answers.

claims.promise: avenSANDBOX's image is built only from theOS/sandbox/box/ by its image workflow, back in .github/workflows/, for amd64 and arm64, tagged by the hash of its inputs, with every tool it had.
claims.fails: The build reads a file outside theOS/, a tool goes missing, or the same inputs build twice.
claims.check: A push that changes theOS/sandbox/box/ builds it; a push with the same inputs builds nothing; inside it, each tool answers its --version; its tag's inputs are all under theOS/.

claims.promise: theOS's check runs inside the image and gives the same report in every scenario: a cloud session, the image workflow's runner, and a Mac.
claims.fails: The check passes in one scenario and fails in another.
claims.check: The image workflow runs theOS's check inside the new image as its last step; the same check in a cloud session and on a Mac gives the same report.

claims.promise: A new cloud session starts with the box warm, and a session whose warm-up fails or hangs still starts.
claims.fails: A setup error or a hang stops every new session before Claude starts.
claims.check: theOS/sandbox/box/cloud-setup.sh pulls the image and runs theOS's check once, under a 600 s limit; run in a copy with a planted failure and a planted hang, the environment's script exits 0 each time; after you paste it at Gate B, a new session starts with the image there.

outcome.promise: Every theOS check runs in one avenSANDBOX image built from theOS/, the same in every scenario; nothing of avenDB is read to build or warm it.
outcome.how: Read off the image workflow's run, a cloud session and a Mac after Gate B.

checkpoints.adds: avenDB's four workflows parked in .github/workflows-avendb/, with a README and a note atop the repository's CLAUDE.md. Done at your direct ask (D-24), commit 2d6f53842.
The box moves: Dockerfile and tag.mjs to theOS/sandbox/box/, every tool kept, inputs read from theOS/ only; avensandbox-image.yml back in .github/workflows/, pointed there.
After AIP-1's checkpoint 1: theOS's check run inside the image, as the image workflow's last step.
theOS/sandbox/box/cloud-setup.sh and the environment's new setup script, for you to paste at Gate B.

deferred.what: Compiling theOS's own crates into the image (avenDB's deps step, reborn)

mockup: The image workflow's run: built for both platforms, each tool's version, theOS's check green inside it
A new cloud session: the image there, theOS's check green
